title: Supplier import mapping (B9)
description: Contract for mappings/<vendor>.yaml, consumed by ingest/mapping.py and ingest/importer.py. One file per supplier translates free-form spreadsheet headers into UMR v2 fields. Validated in the CI static job by scripts/check_mappings.py.

vendor.description: Short vendor id. Used in log messages and as the default source_system.

source_system.description: Value written to identifier / measure / price source_system. Defaults to vendor.

defaults.description: Fallback values for material columns that the sheet does not supply.

extra_headers.description: What to do with unmatched columns. 'attributes' copies them into src.<slug> attributes; 'ignore' drops them.

name_template.description: Python str.format template for the material name. Every placeholder must name a field key or a defaults key.

key.description: Name used in templates and family rules; also an implicit header alias.

target.description: Where the cell value goes in the UMR draft.

kind.description: material_identifier.kind. Defaults to supplier_code when omitted.

column.description: Required for target: column. Names the material column to fill.

measure_key.description: Required for target: measure. Key written to material_measure, aligned with material_profile.field_schema.

unit.description: UCUM unit for a measure, e.g. mm or deg.

required.description: Fail the whole import when no header matches this field.

aliases.description: Alternative supplier headers, matched after normalization.

allOf.description: A column field must say which column it fills; the importer would otherwise use the field key as a column name.
A measure field must name its measure key; the field key is usually not a valid measure key.

key.description: Field keys (or defaults keys) whose values form the family key.

axis.description: Variant axes. A measure field contributes its measure_key to variant_values.
